data.name: Fauji Cement Company Limited
data.description: Fauji Cement Company Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan on 23 November 1992 under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (Repealed with the enactment of the Companies Act, 2017 on May 30, 2017). The Company commenced its business with effect from 22 May 1993. The principal activity of the Company is manufacturing and sale of different types of cement.
